id.description: User id. Use `me` to reference the current user.

year.description: Filter results to the given year. Defaults to the current year if not provided. — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: list_user_non_working_times)

_type.description: Body field _type — enum: UserNonWorkingTime (operations: create_user_non_working_time, update_user_non_working_time, create_user_working_hours, update_user_working_hours_record)

startDate.description: The first date of the non-working time range in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). (operations: create_user_non_working_time, update_user_non_working_time)

endDate.description:
The last date of the non-working time range in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).
Must be greater than or equal to `startDate`. (operations: create_user_non_working_time, update_user_non_working_time)

non_working_time_id.description: The id of the personal non-working time record. — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: delete_user_non_working_time, get_user_non_working_time, update_user_non_working_time)

validFrom.description:
The date from which this working hours configuration is in effect (ISO 8601 format).
Multiple records may exist for a user; the one with the latest `validFrom` that is
not in the future is the currently active record. (operations: create_user_working_hours, update_user_working_hours_record)

mondayHours.description: Hours worked on Monday. — number >= 0 (operations: create_user_working_hours, update_user_working_hours_record)

tuesdayHours.description: Hours worked on Tuesday. — number >= 0 (operations: create_user_working_hours, update_user_working_hours_record)

wednesdayHours.description: Hours worked on Wednesday. — number >= 0 (operations: create_user_working_hours, update_user_working_hours_record)

thursdayHours.description: Hours worked on Thursday. — number >= 0 (operations: create_user_working_hours, update_user_working_hours_record)

fridayHours.description: Hours worked on Friday. — number >= 0 (operations: create_user_working_hours, update_user_working_hours_record)

saturdayHours.description: Hours worked on Saturday. — number >= 0 (operations: create_user_working_hours, update_user_working_hours_record)

sundayHours.description: Hours worked on Sunday. — number >= 0 (operations: create_user_working_hours, update_user_working_hours_record)

availabilityFactor.description: The percentage of working hours the user is available. Must be between 0 and 100. — integer >= 0 (numeric string ok) (operations: create_user_working_hours, update_user_working_hours_record)

working_hours_id.description: Working hours record id. — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: delete_user_working_hours_record, get_user_working_hours_record, update_user_working_hours_record)

confirmed.description: Optional. Two-Phase write confirm: set confirmed=true (or ja/yes/1) to execute POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE. Without it, mutating calls return a confirmation ask.
